description: Source code for passphrase management and password file modification in a system utility, including functions for creating password entries, changing passwords, and reading/writing password data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function parsing command-line arguments and initiating passphrase setup.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Handles passphrase input, verification, and updates the password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes the password in the password file, creating backups.

methods.name: t_makepwent
methods.description: Creates a new password entry with SRP parameters based on user credentials.

methods.name: t_pwcopy
methods.description: Copies password entries from source to destination, optionally replacing an entry.

methods.name: t_getpwent
methods.description: Reads the next password entry from the password file or NIS.

methods.name: t_putpwent
methods.description: Writes a password entry to a file.
